decision: Should the challenge dev command require Verifier authorization?
whyItMatters: Challenge mutates governed state and must have the same authorization boundary as other mutating dev commands.
evidence: challengeCommand already calls require_operator at entry; adding dispatch-level membership must not cause a duplicate authorization prompt.
recommended: Add challenge to MUTATING_DEV_COMMANDS and document it among gated verbs.
alternative: Leave challenge outside the canonical mutating command set.
